# library

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(janitor)
```

# import

```{r}

tuesdata <- tidytuesdayR::tt_load('2026-07-21')

nde_experiences_raw <- tuesdata$nde_experiences

```

# data clean checklist

## check data types

```{r cleaning_datatypes}

nde_experiences_raw |> 
  glimpse()

```

# sandbox

## experiences by year

```{r}

nde_experiences_raw |> 
  mutate(
    year = year(exp_date)
  ) |> 
  group_by(year) |> 
  summarize(
    n_exp = n()
  ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n_exp)) +
  geom_col()

```
